title: Switch tick classification from Jev to Clef-flash and re-run the starting-tier evaluation
description: Cloudflare launched Clef and Clef-flash on Workers AI (2026-10-01, https://blog.cloudflare.com/clef-decision-models/): open-source (Apache-2.0) decision models, API-compatible with Typesafe's Jev, Clef-flash ~39 ms median vs Jev ~524 ms; Clef (Qwen3.8-27B) adds a vision encoder and 64k context. ticfac classifies ticks with Jev (internal/jev, typesafe/jev via Workers AI ai/run) for tier routing; ms9 measured the current mass rule at AUC 0.42 (no signal). Do: make the classifier model configurable, default to Clef-flash (keep Jev selectable), verify the answer shape is identical, and re-run ms9's evaluation (recorded classifications vs attempt outcomes) with Clef and Clef-flash. Note Cloudflare's RL fine-tuning on AI Gateway traffic (currently via their forward-deployed team) as the path to a router trained on our own outcomes — record what data we'd need.
notes: 2026-10-04 11:59 - EVALUATION DONE (2026-10-04), report docs/classifier-eval-2026-10-04-jev-clef.md, harness benchmarks/classifiers. Model ids: @cf/cloudflare/clef, @cf/cloudflare/clef-flash. 127 ticks (ms9's 108 + hn6's recorded asks), 96 with ms9 outcome labels. AUC(dear mass -> HARD): Jev 0.42, Clef-flash 0.42, Clef 0.37 (ms9: 0.42); no model has signal. Latency end to end (median/p95): Jev 276/366 ms, Clef-flash 281/522, Clef 517/932. 0 failures in 762 calls. FOR THE IMPLEMENTATION HALF: (1) the answer shape is NOT identical, Clef answers at result.answers (Jev result.result.answers) and internal/jev refuses it, so a bare model swap makes every classification unavailable; (2) Clef distributions are flat (median top prob 0.37 flash), mass>0.75 routes 0/127 dear, so mass_threshold must be per model (Clef-flash 0.50 matches Jev 0.75's dear share and FAILED catches). Recommendation: keep Jev default until both are fixed; the routing rule (not the classifier) is what lacks signal.
acceptance_criteria: [1] Classification runs on Clef-flash by default, Jev still selectable; go test ./internal/jev/... passes. [2] An evaluation report (Jev vs Clef vs Clef-flash on recorded ticks: agreement, AUC vs outcome, latency) is committed. [3] make gate passes.
